policy.scope_zh: 全量发现 CoinGecko stock 类型 RWA 与 tokenized-stock 分类；以各自稳定 ID 去重并对账，不设市值门槛。stock 类型不自动代表已上市美股；ETF、商品不并入股票目录。
policy.scope_en: Discover every supported stock RWA and tokenized-stock member, reconcile stable IDs, with no market-cap floor. Stock type does not establish US listing status. ETFs and commodities are separate.
policy.identity_zh: 底层 RWA ID、代币 coin ID 与网络/合约分层记录；股票到代币可一对多。标签只是发现依据，未验证的上市市场与映射标为未知。
policy.identity_en: Keep underlying RWA IDs, coin IDs and network/contracts separate; one stock can map to many tokens. Unverified listing markets and identity links remain unknown.
policy.collection_zh: 目录完整扫描；分页到末页，按稳定 ID 去重，重页/漏页/429 不得标成全量成功。保留本轮 ID 集、页数、去重数、截止时间及失败原因；完整对账后才确认新增/移除。目录/元数据低频更新，行情按分页批量更新，历史按 ID 与范围分批补齐。实际频率待 key 权限、缓存与预算核验，不启动定时器。
policy.collection_en: Scan through the last page and deduplicate stable IDs. Missing/duplicate pages and 429 never establish complete coverage. Freeze IDs, page counts, cutoff and errors per round; reconcile before accepting removals. Refresh metadata less often than batched markets; backfill history by ID/range. Cadence requires quota/cache validation; no timer is started.
policy.history_zh: 保留来源、实体层级、USD、上游时间、请求/接收时间与覆盖版本；prices / market_caps / total_volumes 是时间点序列，不是 OHLCV。滚动24小时成交额不能跨点相加；聚合 RWA 与单代币序列不可混算。
policy.history_en: Retain source, entity level, USD, source/request/receive time and coverage version. Chart series are not OHLCV; rolling 24-hour volume points cannot be summed. Never mix aggregate and individual-token series.
policy.limits_zh: 真实采集、全量历史回填、Stocks App 与榜单运行链尚未实现。代币行情不代表原股行情，代币市值不代表公司市值。历史套餐、映射全覆盖、实际延迟和成本未验证。
policy.limits_en: No live crawler, full historical backfill, Stocks app or ranking runtime is delivered. Token metrics are not underlying stock metrics. Plan permissions, full mapping, latency and cost remain unverified.

cards.purpose_zh: 目录完整扫描；分页到末页，按稳定 ID 去重，重页/漏页/429 不得标成全量成功。保留本轮 ID 集、页数、去重数、截止时间及失败原因；完整对账后才确认新增/移除。目录/元数据低频更新，行情按分页批量更新，历史按 ID 与范围分批补齐。实际频率待 key 权限、缓存与预算核验，不启动定时器。
cards.purpose_en: Scan through the last page and deduplicate stable IDs. Missing/duplicate pages and 429 never establish complete coverage. Freeze IDs, page counts, cutoff and errors per round; reconcile before accepting removals. Refresh metadata less often than batched markets; backfill history by ID/range. Cadence requires quota/cache validation; no timer is started.

cards.name: coingecko.stocks.universe
cards.purpose_zh: 全量发现 CoinGecko stock 类型 RWA 与 tokenized-stock 分类；以各自稳定 ID 去重并对账，不设市值门槛。stock 类型不自动代表已上市美股；ETF、商品不并入股票目录。
cards.purpose_en: Discover every supported stock RWA and tokenized-stock member, reconcile stable IDs, with no market-cap floor. Stock type does not establish US listing status. ETFs and commodities are separate.

cards.name: coingecko.stocks.identity
cards.label_zh: Stocks · 核对股票与代币身份
cards.purpose_zh: 底层 RWA ID、代币 coin ID 与网络/合约分层记录；股票到代币可一对多。标签只是发现依据，未验证的上市市场与映射标为未知。
cards.purpose_en: Keep underlying RWA IDs, coin IDs and network/contracts separate; one stock can map to many tokens. Unverified listing markets and identity links remain unknown.

cards.name: coingecko.stocks.mapping
cards.purpose_zh: 设计表；一只股票可有多个代币版本，冲突/未映射保留待核对，不冒充已验证身份。
cards.purpose_en: Design table: preserve one-to-many identities and unresolved/conflicting mappings.

cards.name: coingecko.stocks.normalize
cards.label_zh: Stocks · 行情与历史标准化
cards.purpose_zh: 保留来源、实体层级、USD、上游时间、请求/接收时间与覆盖版本；prices / market_caps / total_volumes 是时间点序列，不是 OHLCV。滚动24小时成交额不能跨点相加；聚合 RWA 与单代币序列不可混算。
cards.purpose_en: Retain source, entity level, USD, source/request/receive time and coverage version. Chart series are not OHLCV; rolling 24-hour volume points cannot be summed. Never mix aggregate and individual-token series.

cards.name: coingecko.stocks.history
cards.purpose_zh: 保留来源、实体层级、USD、上游时间、请求/接收时间与覆盖版本；prices / market_caps / total_volumes 是时间点序列，不是 OHLCV。滚动24小时成交额不能跨点相加；聚合 RWA 与单代币序列不可混算。
cards.purpose_en: Retain source, entity level, USD, source/request/receive time and coverage version. Chart series are not OHLCV; rolling 24-hour volume points cannot be summed. Never mix aggregate and individual-token series.

cards.name: coingecko.stocks.coverage
cards.purpose_zh: 设计记录每轮页数、ID 数、响应缺失/限流、重复冲突、零成交与历史不足。失败/未知不得显示为成功空市场；不删除目录成员。
cards.purpose_en: Design per-round page/ID counts, missing responses, rate limits, duplicates, zero trades and insufficient history. Unknown coverage is not an empty healthy market.

cards.name: coingecko.stocks.metrics
cards.label_zh: Stocks · Stocks 指标适配边界
cards.purpose_zh: 复用历史读取与指标函数，但以 Stocks 范围和单代币口径独立输入；无全量历史/覆盖不得生成正常榜单。当前仅定义接口，未绑定现有Crypto榜单或执行计算。
cards.purpose_en: Reuse history and metric functions with a separate Stocks cohort and token-level inputs. Missing coverage/history blocks normal rankings. Interface only; no Crypto ranking binding or execution.

verification.interruption: HTTP 429 on page 5; do not claim complete count
